commands.purpose: Serve agent tools over MCP stdio (2025-11-25); held roots reject all symlinks, allow hard-linked files and retain moved directories.
commands.stdout: Newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0; diagnostics on stderr; EOF exits 0. Request caps: max(32,line_bytes/64) nodes, line_bytes/2 UTF-8 string/key bytes, depth 32; duplicate keys refused. Protocol errors for malformed calls; argument/operation failures are isError unityrs.error results. TPK work/memory share request ceilings. Extract raw names use {t:str,hex:...}.
